snippet.title: Haunted - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer - UPGRADED GRAPHICS!
snippet.description:
HAUNTED is an asymmetrical co-op horror game where you explore a cursed dollhouse using supernatural powers, unlock terrifying rooms, and survive together—or alone. Think “Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes” meets “Phasmophobia”.

One player, the Supervisor, stays outside, while up to three Explorers are trapped inside the life-sized, nightmarish version of the dollhouse: Woodman Manor. Every playthrough is different, and no one is safe. As the Explorers navigate haunted corridors and flee from lurking entities, they must communicate with their Supervisor to solve puzzles and escape before it’s too late.

Wishlist now: https://bit.ly/hauntedYT

🧩 Puzzle + Survival : Shift between moments of tense problem-solving and high-stakes survival in a dark, atmospheric Victorian setting.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Asymmetrical Co-op: Communication is everything. Supervisor and Explorers must rely on each other to make it out alive.

🔀 Built for replayability: Unlock new rooms as you progress. Puzzles evolve with each run. Procedural elements ensure a fresh layout every session. Discover hidden storylines, unearth buried trauma, and face your fears—again and again.

Will you escape the dollhouse... or become just another whisper in the walls?

Join our Discord to know more: https://discord.com/invite/KVkASPcV7u
